_note: Core motion vocabulary (brand-free). A technique is a motion format: its layouts and the classes it allows. A brand may limit itself to some techniques with motion.techniques in its profile. Phrases become the direction Claude Motion follows.

story.safe: keep words and the logo clear of the top 250 px, the bottom 420 px and the right 120 px, where the apps draw over the film

post.safe: keep words and the logo at least 80 px from every edge

square.safe: keep words and the logo at least 80 px from every edge

wide.safe: keep words and the logo at least 96 px from every edge

roles._note: What a block is. size: its default size class; type: the brand type role it is set in.

eyebrow.say: the eyebrow, in the main color

note.say: the small note, quiet but legible

stat.say: the big number, in the main color

classes._note: Fixed vocabulary. kind: size, enter (one per block), hold (one per block), exit. Placeholders: {at} {from} {stagger}.

rise.say: rises about 30 px into place as it fades in

slide.say: slides in from the left edge, easing out

words.say: enters word by word from the right (about 110 ms apart)

type.say: types out letter by letter, about 24 a second

count.say: counts from {from} to its value in whole steps, no faster than three changes a second, and lands with a small settle

pop.say: pops in with a small overshoot

grow.say: grows from a dot to full size with a gentle settle

wipe.say: is revealed by a wipe from left to right

drop.say: drops into place from above and settles

build.say: builds piece by piece ({stagger} s apart)

drift.say: while held, drifts about 2 px a second

breathe.say: while held, breathes in scale by about 1 % on a 3 s cycle

float.say: while held, floats up and down a few px

pan.say: while held, pushes in slowly (2 % over the hold)

out.say: fades out before the scene ends

music.calm: a calm, warm wordless score: a soft pad and an electric piano, a light pulse, rising into the end card
music.bright: a bright, mid-tempo wordless score: marimba and a light kit, building into the end card

stat-story.name: Stat story
stat-story.look: Number-led brand data story: big numbers that count, charts that build, calm eased type, flat shapes in the brand palette, one accent doing one job

title.say: Opening card: the title is already readable at frame 0 (the thumbnail).

stat.say: One number carries the scene; it arrives first and everything else follows it.

chart.say: A chart builds in order of the data; the highlighted values land last.

compare.say: Before and after side by side or stacked; the change is what moves.

list.say: A short list, one item at a time.

quote.say: A quote, set large, with its attribution.

closing.say: End card: held at least 3 s, the logo lands on the score's last hit, nothing else moves after it settles.

rules: One number per stat scene; the number is the biggest thing on screen.
Counts and charts reach their real values from the format file, never rounded or changed.

kinetic.name: Kinetic type
kinetic.look: Type-led brand film: one idea per scene, lines enter word by word from one direction, the accent word lands and stays, flat ground in the brand palette

title.say: Opening card: the title is already readable at frame 0 (the thumbnail).

statement.say: One statement fills the frame; words move, nothing else competes.

list.say: A short list, one item at a time, each replacing or stacking on the last.

quote.say: A quote, set large, with its attribution.

closing.say: End card: held at least 3 s, the logo lands on the score's last hit, nothing else moves after it settles.

rules: Words always enter from the same side across the whole film.
Emphasis is motion or the accent color on the one starred word, never bold or exclamation marks.
